title: 第3837章 白发老妪第3836章 被随从反杀
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 说完这些，他不甘心的闭上了眼睛。
他估计怎么都没有想到，最后不是死在敌人的手里，而是死在了保护他的这些随从身上，真是太荒谬，太可笑了。
只可惜他不能提前预判未来，他但凡有未卜先知的能力，说什么也要将这些随从全部给弄死。
随从看向苏长歌，道：“前辈，我们已经按照您的嘱咐杀了他，我们是不是可以离开了？”
说实话，他们还是有些担心的，万一对方不认账，出尔反尔，他们也只能干瞪眼。
苏长歌看出了他们的心思，微微一笑，说道：“你们不必紧张，既然说了，就不会食言，你们可以离开了。”
听到这话，三名随从顿时松了一口气，心里的石头总算落了地。
“多谢前辈，那我们就先告辞了！”
对方虽然愿意放他们一马，但是他们并不是绝对安全的，他们杀了公子，公子背后的势力断然不会放过他们了，所以他们得赶紧跑路，有多远跑多远。
他们刚要离开，这时一股恐怖的威压顿时席卷而来，压得他们喘不过气来。
感知到这股威压后，他们莫名觉得很熟悉，突然间想起了什么，脸色全都变了又变。
“这是……公子的救兵来了……”
“早……早知道会来，但没想到居然这……这么快，这难道就是……是我们的命吗？”
无尽的恐惧顿时笼罩在他们的心里，此刻他们连话都说不利索了，甚至连逃跑都忘记了。
就在他们愣神之际，只见虚空之中走出来一名白发老妪。
这名白发老妪周身席卷着恐怖至极的气息波动，让人毛骨悚然，不敢靠近分毫。
她一来就爆发噬血杀意，居高临下的问道：“是谁杀了我的曾孙，你们最好主动站出来，要不然在场所有人都是给我曾孙陪葬！”
闻言，那三名随从根本不敢站出来承认，吓都要吓死了，此刻他们的魂都要吓飞了，腿脚更是发软，忍不住颤抖起来。
白发老妪注意到了这三名随从，冷声道：“你们不是我给曾孙挑选的随从吗？怎么你们好好的，我曾孙却死了？”
“你们为什么还好好的，你们应该下去给他陪葬的！”
说着，白发老妪拂袖一挥，顿时朝那三名随从而去。
那三名随从根本就猝不及防，更没想到对方居然一言不合就要对他们大开杀戒，他们没有反应的功夫，只能下意识的用手抵挡。
但是他们的反抗对有着轮回境八重的白发老妪来说简直是不值一提，跟挠痒痒没什么区别。
几个呼吸过后。
那三名随从的气息被抹除，好像从来没有存在过一样。
他们临死的时候，甚至没来得及发出一句求饶。
杀了那几名随从后，白发老妪冷冷扫了苏长歌等人一眼，不屑的道，“该你们了！”
叶清瑶能行以上，不悦的道：“你连什么情况都没搞清楚，就要杀人，这未免也太霸道了些！”
“一言不合就要杀人，真是荒谬至极！”紫月不满的吐槽道：“我们还没有说话，就给我们定罪了，你以为你是谁啊？”
狂妄的反派，她见过不少，但向对方如此嚣张的，她还是第一次见。
白发老妪冷笑一声，满不在乎的道：“本座杀人不需要理由，心情不好，想杀就杀了！”
“如果非要一个理由，那就是我曾孙死了，本座要找人给他们陪葬，我曾孙喜欢美女，你们几个长的不错，我曾孙肯定喜欢，你们下去陪他吧！”
叶清瑶皱起眉头，不满的道：“你曾孙又不是我们杀的，凭什么要我们给他陪葬？”
“这重要吗？”白发老妪笑了笑，开口道：“既然你们要一个理由，那本座就给你们一个理由，凭本座的修为比你们高，这够吗？”
叶清瑶嗤笑一声，不以为然的道：“修为高又怎么，就可以为所欲为了吗？”
“当然。”白发老妪随口说道，语气平淡无比，压根没把这些人放在心上。
“呵呵。”苏长歌冷笑一声，道：“那我也可以对你为所欲为了。”
“你这话什么意思？”白发老妪皱了皱眉头，疑惑的道。

content_en:
After saying this, he closed his eyes unwillingly.
He probably never thought that he would not die in the hands of his enemies in the end, but in the hands of the followers who protected him. It was so ridiculous and ridiculous.
It's a pity that he can't predict the future in advance. If he has the ability to predict the future, he will kill all these followers no matter what.
The entourage looked at Su Changge and said, "Senior, we have killed him according to your instructions. Can we leave?"
To be honest, they are still a little worried. If the other party refuses to admit their fault and goes back on their word, they can only stare blankly.
Su Changge saw what they were thinking, smiled slightly, and said, "You don't have to be nervous. Since I said it, I won't break my promise. You can leave."
Hearing this, the three followers breathed a sigh of relief, and the stone in their hearts finally fell to the ground.
"Thank you, senior, let's take our leave now!"
Although the other party is willing to let them go, they are not absolutely safe. If they kill the young master, the forces behind the young master will definitely not let them go, so they have to run away as quickly as possible.
Just as they were about to leave, a terrifying pressure suddenly swept over them, making them breathless.
After sensing this pressure, they felt inexplicably familiar. Suddenly they remembered something, and their expressions all changed again and again.
"This is... the young master's reinforcements are coming..."
"I knew it would come... but I didn't expect it to happen... so soon. Is this... our fate?"
Endless fear suddenly enveloped their hearts. At this moment, they were speechless and even forgot about escaping.
Just when they were stunned, they saw a white-haired old woman walking out of the void.
This white-haired old woman's body was filled with extremely terrifying aura fluctuations, making people's hair stand on end and not daring to come even close.
She burst out with bloodthirsty murderous intent as soon as she arrived, and asked condescendingly: "Who killed my great-grandson? You'd better come forward, otherwise everyone present will be buried with my great-grandson!"
Hearing this, the three followers didn't dare to stand up and admit it. They were scared to death. At this moment, their souls were scared to death. Their legs and feet were even weak and they couldn't help but tremble.
The white-haired old woman noticed the three followers and said coldly: "Aren't you the followers I selected for my great-grandson? Why are you so good, but my great-grandson is dead?"
"Why are you still fine? You should go down and bury him with him!"
As he spoke, the white-haired old woman waved her sleeves and immediately walked towards the three followers.
The three followers were completely caught off guard, and they did not expect that the other party would kill them at the slightest disagreement. They had no time to react and could only subconsciously resist with their hands.
But their resistance was nothing to the white-haired old woman with the eighth level of reincarnation, no different from scratching an itch.
After a few breaths.
The auras of the three followers were wiped out, as if they had never existed.
When they were dying, they didn't even have time to utter a word of begging for mercy.
After killing those followers, the white-haired old woman glanced coldly at Su Changge and others, and said disdainfully, "It's your turn!"
Ye Qingyao could do more than that and said displeasedly: "You don't even understand the situation and you want to kill people. This is too overbearing!"
"It's so ridiculous to kill people just because they don't agree with each other!" Ziyue complained dissatisfiedly: "We were convicted before we even spoke. Who do you think you are?"
She had seen many arrogant villains, but this was the first time she had seen him so arrogant.
The white-haired old woman sneered and said nonchalantly: "I don't need a reason to kill. If you're in a bad mood, just kill if you want!"
"If I have to have one reason, it would be that my great-grandson is dead, and I want to find someone to bury them with him. My great-grandson likes beautiful women. You guys are good-looking, and my great-grandson will definitely like it. You go down and accompany him!"
Ye Qingyao frowned and said dissatisfied: "Your great-grandson was not killed by us, why should we bury him with him?"
"Is this important?" The white-haired old woman smiled and said, "Since you want a reason, I will give you a reason. Since my cultivation level is higher than yours, is this enough?"
Ye Qingyao sneered and said disapprovingly: "It doesn't matter if you have high cultivation level, can you do whatever you want?"
"Of course." The white-haired old woman said casually, her tone was extremely calm, and she didn't take these people to heart at all.
"Haha." Su Changge sneered and said, "Then I can do whatever I want to you."
"What do you mean by that?" The white-haired old woman frowned and asked in confusion.
